title: Outside-tool gaps: Client Connector Terraform (notification templates, ZIA posture), Excel device lists, domain user names, traffic logs without uploading, assistant tools

checks.what: every zcc argument written (fail-open, device cleanup, web privacy, notification templates, ZIA posture) is one the pinned provider 0.1.2-beta.3 declares, nested attributes included

zip bomb (ratio, total size, entry count), DTD/entity and oversize workbooks refused; a normal one parses; a sheet over the row, cell, column or shared-string cap is refused, streamed with bounded memory
domain user names need the server-checked personal-data tick, are CSV-injection safe, no-store, and the audit holds only the count
each new assistant tool answers counts on the sample tenant and refuses an unticked scope before any read; no person named
the new route and the traffic-log watch and syslog routes have team rules and a write classification; the syslog clear needs a writer and is audited
the ZIA posture profile list is reported as possibly incomplete, never as complete

findings.title: The traffic-log watch and syslog listener routes had no team-mode rule and no write-safety classification, and the syslog clear needed no writer and was not audited
findings.fix: Team rules (admin), write-safety classification, require_writer and an audit record on the clear.

findings.title: The workbook reader capped each part's size but not the expansion ratio or the total declared size
findings.fix: Per-part ratio cap (200x past 1 MB) checked before and after reading, and a 96 MB total declared size cap.

findings.title: Client Connector notification templates and ZIA posture profiles were listed as not exported
findings.fix: Raw GET at the provider's v2 paths (assumed shape), written in the provider's nested-attribute form.

findings.title: The whole-tenant export treated the ZIA posture profile list as complete, though the API is documented to cut it short silently
findings.fix: Every export that reads the list says it may be incomplete, with the count read (report, export_report.json, READMEs, job result, Exports page).

findings.title: The workbook reader parsed a whole sheet part into memory (734 MB peak for a 3 MB upload) and cut a sheet past the row cap short instead of refusing it
findings.fix: Streamed iterative parse with the caps checked as bytes are inflated; a sheet over the row, filled-cell, column or shared-string cap is refused, reading stopping at the cap.

findings.title: No test proved that clearing or stopping the syslog listener needs the writer and is audited
findings.fix: Tests: without the writer clear and stop are 403 and keep the lines; with it each writes its audit record.

findings.title: The release notes said every new assistant tool checks the server's scope, though the case-notes tools (local notes) take no Scope key
findings.fix: The CHANGELOG says which tools check scope and that the case-notes tools work on the app's local notes.
